description.en_us: Orbit Launcher ver 1.0.2: Fixed custom control & SDL3 keybind mappings, added MJ Launcher (MojoLauncher) v9 & ZIP control layout import, added 720p/1080p 30/60 FPS gameplay recorder options, and fixed tri-cluster CPU affinity, EGL swapInterval/VSync, and OpenGL ES 3.2/3.1 LTW context bottlenecks. Join https://discord.gg/7FaUJf4R9
description.zh_cn: Orbit Launcher ver 1.0.2：修复自定义按键与 SDL3 键位映射、新增 MJ Launcher (MojoLauncher) v9 与 ZIP 控制布局导入、新增 720p/1080p 30/60 FPS 录屏选项，并修复三丛集 CPU 亲和性、EGL swapInterval/垂直同步与 OpenGL ES 3.2/3.1 LTW 上下文帧率瓶颈。官方社区：https://discord.gg/7FaUJf4R9
description.zh_tw: Orbit Launcher ver 1.0.2：修復自訂按鍵與 SDL3 鍵位映射、新增 MJ Launcher (MojoLauncher) v9 與 ZIP 控制佈局匯入、新增 720p/1080p 30/60 FPS 錄影選項，並修復三叢集 CPU 親和性、EGL swapInterval/垂直同步與 OpenGL ES 3.2/3.1 LTW 上下文幀率瓶頸。官方社群：https://discord.gg/7FaUJf4R9
